text:
claire: Hey team — trying to e-sign my 401k enrollment from my phone and the DocuSign flow keeps redirecting to a blank page after I tap 'Sign'. Anyone seen this? Using iPhone Safari. Curious about payroll cutoff for this cycle.

linda (People Ops): Sorry you're hitting that, @claire. We had a vendor rollout last week; some mobile browsers can hit an SSO redirect loop. Can you try Chrome mobile or an incognito window? Also — did you use the company SSO button or the direct link we emailed?

claire: I used the 'Sign with SSO' button. Tried incognito — still blank. The page briefly shows "403 Forbidden — missing token" before going white.

docusign-bot: DocuSign: signature request ds-0x9a... attempted. Redirect error logged 2026-03-22T09:12Z. Ref ID: ds-7f4b

sam: Workaround if you need it before payroll cutoff — download the PDF from the portal, sign locally (Preview/Adobe), and upload the signed PDF to hr-benefits@redwood.com. We can accept that as a manual submission. @linda, payroll ok with manual uploads?

linda (People Ops): Yes — we can accept a signed PDF as an exception. Please include your employee ID (last 4) and date signed in the email. If you'd rather, we can also submit on your behalf once we have the file. I'll escalate the Ref ID to the vendor to get the Safari SSO redirect fixed.

payroll-bot: Payroll reminder: Final day to submit 401k enrollments for the 03/28 payroll is 03/25 EOD. Files uploaded to benefits-inbox by 23:59 PST will be processed for this cycle.

claire: Thanks — I switched to mobile Chrome and it worked. Signed and uploaded the PDF to hr-benefits@redwood.com. Sent employee ID and date in the email. Appreciate the fast responses :thumbsup:

linda (People Ops): Great — marking received and noting the vendor Ref ID. If anyone else runs into the Safari/SSO issue please DM me the Ref ID and device/browser. We'll push for a vendor patch and update the benefits guide with a mobile workaround.
